{{Top|leg}}
A '''haba''' was a communal community of [[Brubb]]s that ranged in size from ten to ten-thousand individuals. The habas served unique functions from education to interstellar transportation. As the habas were communal environments, children born into the community were raised by the entire haba and traded to other habas when old enough to mate.
